title: Guided tour opens over every page for new visitors; its default contradicts the flag docs
steps: Start the local stack (flag at its code default).
expected: Per FEATURE_FLAGS.md the tour is off by default; if enabled, it should not stand between a returning user and signing in.
actual: The flag is on for 100% in code. A modal tour opens on each page separately on first visit — 10 steps on /landing, 6 on /login, 9 on /register, 5 on /marketplace — covering the form until skipped. It is accessible (dialog role, focus trap, Escape, 'Skip guide'). It also caused 10 of the 20 local E2E failures.
impact: Every new visitor must dismiss up to four tours before signing up or buying; extra friction on the key conversion pages. The code/doc conflict needs an owner decision.
fix: OWNER DECISION: is the default on or off? Then either set the code default to match FEATURE_FLAGS.md, or update the doc. Independently: do not auto-open on /login, /register, /forgot-password, /reset-password; offer the tour from the launcher there, or show one 'Take a quick tour?' prompt once per browser.
